name: Miracle Tower
tagline: Luxury high rise in the heart of Pattaya

directSale.funnelCopy: Completed in 2025, Miracle Tower rises 29 storeys over central Pattaya's 3rd Road, putting the city's beaches, dining and nightlife a short walk away. Its 476 residences range from smart studios to 1-bedroom homes, above ground-floor shop units, with a full resort amenity deck. A finished, move-in-ready address in the heart of the city.

Parkgate is the first-delivering block of Parkgate City, a “city within a city” of landscaped courtyards and shared amenity in central Pattaya. Its 198 efficient studios, 1- and 2-bedroom homes are built around a green social podium with pool and fitness. On completion in 2027 it will open as the established heart of the wider community.

Palmgate extends the Parkgate City “city within a city” with a further 198 residences, sharing the same courtyard-and-amenity design language as its sibling blocks. A later phase of the masterplan, it is offered off-plan for buyers who want to secure a home in the community early, ahead of a 2029 handover.

name: Garden Court
tagline: City-centre living with a tropical heart

directSale.funnelCopy: Garden Court wraps city-centre living around a tropical heart: a lush garden courtyard, lagoon pool and cascading planting at the core of an 8-storey low-rise on Pattaya Klang. Its 188 studios, 1- and 2-bedroom homes are designed as a resort retreat in the middle of the city, with handover planned for 2027.

Perched on northpoint Hill, Skyline Tower lifts its 161 residences 20 storeys into the breeze, with sweeping views toward the bay. The mix runs from studios to sea-facing 2-bedrooms, duplexes and panoramic penthouses, served by an infinity sky-deck pool. Elevated, finished living a step above the city.

Gardengate brings 134 residences to the Parkgate City “city within a city”, from compact 1-bedrooms to larger 2-bedroom homes, around the shared landscaped courtyards and pool. A mid-phase delivery of the masterplan, it is designed to hand over in 2028 into an already-living community.

NorthPoint carries the garden-resort idea up onto northpoint Hill, pairing an elevated green outlook with lagoon-style pool and amenity. Its 79 residences — 1-bedrooms and roomy 2-bedrooms — are designed for hillside resort living a few minutes from the beaches, with a 2028 handover.

SouthBay is NorthPoint's northpoint sibling, a later phase of the same hillside resort living. Its 78 studios and 1-bedroom homes share the same garden-resort design language, offered off-plan ahead of a 2029 handover for buyers securing a hillside home early.

A boutique collection of just 44 residences on the northpoint shoreline, Ocean View is designed for those who want the beach as their front garden. Generous 1- and 2-bedroom homes — up to 113 sqm — open onto the sea, with a beachfront pool and an intimate, private atmosphere. Finished and ready for its first owners.
